transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because my mind feels foggy. I can’t keep my place in my old cataloguing notes, and even deciding what simple thing to do next feels difficult.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling noticeably sad, down, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah. Most days lately I just sit at the kitchen table feeling like all the color has gone out of everything. Even looking at my old watercolor books makes me feel heavy, not interested like I used to.
How long have you been experiencing this combination of low mood and mental fogginess—days, weeks, or longer?
Most days for about three months now. It seemed to start around when I began getting ready to leave the library.
Aside from feeling low, have you noticed things like forgetting recent conversations, losing track of dates, or getting confused in places you know well?
I haven’t really noticed that kind of thing. I’m not getting lost or confused about where I am.
Have you ever had a similar period of low mood and mental fogginess like this before, at some earlier point in your life?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time quite like this off the top of my head.

Thinking back over your whole life, even years ago, was there ever another stretch of at least two weeks where you felt persistently down or lost interest in things, separate from what you're experiencing now?
I’m not sure. Looking back, I can’t clearly remember another stretch like that.
Has anyone close to you—like family or friends—ever mentioned that you went through a period of being noticeably down or withdrawn before this current time?
No, nobody’s said that to me, at least not that I can remember.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately—such as trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?
I go to bed tired, but I’ve been waking up around four in the morning. Then I just lie there thinking about what I’m supposed to do with myself now.
Besides the low mood, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually anxious, worried, or on edge most days, even about things that aren't logically that concerning?
I’m not sure I’d say anxious most days. I do get stuck thinking sometimes, but I wouldn’t call it being on edge.
Have you been feeling unusually worthless, guilty, or overly critical of yourself during this time?
I don’t think so. I’ve been feeling low, but I wouldn’t say I’m blaming myself or feeling especially guilty.
How much are these feelings and difficulties affecting your ability to manage daily tasks, like cooking, cleaning, or taking care of yourself?
It’s affecting me more than I’d like. I’ve let my lecture plans and travel notes pile up, and even basic household paperwork just sits there because I can’t seem to organize myself the way I used to.
